verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const page="app/(public)/housing/[id]/page.tsx",types="lib/listings/types.ts";if(!fs.existsSync(page)||!fs.existsSync(types)){console.error("SCAN-760: housing detail page or listings types missing");process.exit(79)}const s=fs.readFileSync(page,"utf8"),t=fs.readFileSync(types,"utf8");const promise=/Signed-in members see the street address/.test(t);const serverFalse=/signedIn:\s*false/.test(s);const route=fs.existsSync("app/api/housing/[id]/address/route.ts");const serverTrue=/signedIn:\s*true/.test(s);if(promise&&(serverFalse||!serverTrue)&&!route){console.error("SCAN-760: the housing detail page resolves the address with signedIn false and no signed-in address route exists, while lib/listings/types.ts still promises that signed-in members see the street address, so the exact address is shown to nobody.");process.exit(1)}'

append.detail: The housing detail page is ISR and resolved the address with signedIn false, so a host who chose 'Exact address for signed-in members' had their street address shown to nobody while lib/listings/types.ts promised members would see it. Added app/api/housing/[id]/address/route.ts (force-dynamic, no-store private): it checks supabase.auth.getUser(), returns null for anonymous callers or non-active non-housing listings, and otherwise runs resolveAddressDisplay with signedIn true. Added components/marketplace/housing-address.tsx, a client component inside the page's ViewerProvider that fetches the line only once the viewer is signed in and renders the Address row; the page mounts it only when the host chose exact, keeps the address out of the cached HTML, and its comment now says so. Pinned by app/api/housing/[id]/address/route.test.ts (signed-in exact returns the line; anonymous, coarser precision, inactive or non-housing listing return null; no-store header; force-dynamic).
